background_load: Shared laboratory hosts. Official Yelp download to worker1 remained active during Shakespeare comparison; no competing Hadoop job was submitted. OS and other users were not altered.
input_preprocessing: Full Yelp review JSONL is counted as text; no sampling or duplication. Shakespeare terminal newlines normalized equally.
timing: Completed JobHistory job/task finishTime minus startTime. Reduce includes shuffle, sort and reduce.
native_libraries: libhadoop and native zlib loaded on all four architectures. Optional OpenSSL, ISA-L, PMDK absent; no experiment depends on them.
q2_background_load: Yelp download/extraction and then HDFS input upload overlapped Q2 correctness execution. Q2 stage durations are descriptive only, not a controlled performance comparison.
